messages:
zara: quick sanity check  export + csv headers for the Audit Logs view. were shipping an Export CSV button and want clean, explicit headers for compliance teams. posting a sample row below.

eli: nice. headers matter. what are we doing for kms ownership? "KeyOwner" or "KMS Owner"?

mike: prefer machine-friendly snake_case in the csv file: kms_owner, actor_email, action, before, after, policy_id, region, timestamp. but UI-visible header can be humanized.

ana: (typo, should be ana) ana: small UX/copy concern: the label in console currently says `Encryption: Managed`. thats ambiguous for auditors. change to `Key: Customer-managed (BYOK)` or `Key: Redwood-managed (platform)`. keep UI and CSV consistent.

liz: +1. also include a `key_description` column in the CSV that contains the human label for quick scanning: e.g. "Customer-managed (BYOK) - key in customer's KMS". that way compliance teams get context without opening other panels.

katie: accessibility note: when the Export CSV action completes, emit an accessible toast: "Audit export ready: downloaded 1 file" and also offer `Copy CSV to clipboard` option. make sure success/failure messages are announced by screen readers.

zara: sample CSV headers im thinking for the file (human readable headers):
Timestamp, Actor email, Action, Policy ID, Before, After, Key owner, Key description, Region, Source

mike: and sample CSV row (CSV-safe quoting):
"2026-06-03T15:12:09Z","liz@example.com","retention:update","pol_777","30d","90d","customer","Customer-managed (BYOK) - key stored in customer KMS","eu-west-1","console"

eli: for machine parsing we should also expose a JSONL export option later, but CSV is fine now. ensure we document header names in the API docs so infra and auditors know the field meanings.

ana: UI copy tweak: Export button tooltip currently says "Export logs". change to "Export audit logs (CSV)" so users know format. also a small inline helper: "Includes key ownership and region when available."

liz: audit teams asked for explicit actor identifiers. include actor_id if available (or actor_email fallback). add column "Actor ID" after Actor email.

katie: small keyboard flow: after export starts, trap focus on the export modal until file is ready or user cancels. when ready, focus moves to the download link with visible focus ring. screen reader should announce file size.

zara: one more: avoid the phrase "Managed" anywhere alone in the CSV. it gets misinterpreted. always qualify with who manages.

mike: agreed. also ensure CSV columns are stable (dont re-order across releases). bump semver if we must change order. document in release notes.

eli: action items: liz add key_description + actor_id to CSV schema, ana update tooltip copy and UI labels for Key, katie verify a11y toast + focus flow, mike add header names to API docs, zara to update the Export button copy in figma. console-bot: filed ticket AUD-940 to track CSV header changes.

console-bot: Created ticket AUD-940: Add Actor ID and Key description to Audit CSV export.

zara: thanks team. ping here when copy PR is up or if anyone finds text that implies Redwood has customer key access.
